notes: Quick reference guide (pages 7-12): three-column step panels set on the design's art; bold 'Label:' lead-ins are the panels; 'Support and communication – lead clinician to:' is the panel over its lead-in, split at the dash; the footnote on page 8 has no marker in the print and is kept as a footnote of that page.

Tinted boxes (National action, the implementation support checklists, the case studies of Appendix A) are one-cell tables carrying the tint; 'Further information' callouts are accent-coloured headings over their lists, the information icon dropped as design.
Figures 1 (page 16), 2 (page 19) and 3 (page 47) are rendered figures; the wave and dots along each page foot are dropped as design.

Glossary terms that wrap over two lines ('Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander Health Worker –') are one paragraph each; resource-list headings that wrap ('Australian Commission on Safety and Quality in Health Care') are one heading each; the italic 'Info' of HealthInfoNet keeps its bold weight.

Misprints ('Step 4: Step 4: Treatment', '6.4 6.4 Pain management', 'Torres strait') and stakeholder entries the print sets without a gap between them ('Aboriginal Health Service, Tasmania Aboriginal Medical Services Alliance Northern Territory') are kept as printed.
'First published in August 2018. This edition published in October 2024.' on the imprint page; second edition.
Back cover (page 126) carries only the cover artwork.
